title: Momoi Airi — Captivated By Cuteness〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: Wishing to the Blue Sky for Your Happiness!

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Great practice, everyone♪

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Great practice!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We're meeting up for another practice tomorrow, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! We'll be looking forward to it!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. Minori and I may be the only ones joining you guys.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, sorry about that.
Shizuku and I were asked to do some modeling work on short notice.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? Modeling work?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That's so wonderful. What are you going to be modeling?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Believe it or not, a bride.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wow! Does that mean you get to wear a wedding dress?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, that's even more wonderful♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It does. I can't wait either since Shizuku's gonna look absolutely astounding in a wedding dress!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You'll be wearing a dress too, right, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I will. But I'm going to be playing a bridesmaid, so my dress won't be nearly as extravagant as the wedding dress.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wait, what's a bridesmaid?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Someone who assists the bride.
It's a traditional role that traces its roots back to Europe during the middle ages.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Originally, they wore dresses similar to that of the bride to ward off and confuse any evil spirits that envied her happiness.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh wow. That's really cool. I didn't realize they're supposed to protect the bride against evil spirits...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. I know, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But nowadays, they just fix the hem of the bride's dress, take care of the bouquet or keep her ring safe until the exchange.

rows.Speaker: Miku & Luka
rows.Line: Whoa!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow, a bridesmaid...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The bride's wonderful and all, but it's gotta be really satisfying to be there for her as one of her bridesmaids during her happiest moment!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Definitely. And I'm gonna do my best since you personally asked for me, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I'd like to see you in a wedding dress as well, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What? Me? I really don't think I'd be able to pull one off.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, I disagree!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: She's right. I'm sure you'd look absolutely adorable♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Adorable...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hmm... I mean, I've always wanted to try wearing one, but I honestly can't imagine how I'd actually look...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: In that case, we could look up some dresses online while imagining how she'd look in them! I'm sure we'll have plenty of search results to choose from!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I agree! By doing that, we should be able to find the perfect wedding dress for Airi♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, that sounds fun! I'd like to help.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yeah, me too♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: W-Wait, you guys, slow down!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It sounds like they're all really interested in seeing how you'd look in a wedding dress, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Aren't you also just a little bit curious?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh? I mean, yeah...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright, it'll be fun to see what kind of dresses they end up choosing for you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, it sure will.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And we'll also join in on the fun and search for the perfect wedding dress. Right, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, let's.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, you guys too?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, Haruka, Len!
Look at this dress! I think it looks really nice...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The base color's white, but the frills and ribbons are just ever-so-slightly colored.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, that is nice. It's such a cute design.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It really is. It'll go great with Airi's bright personality. I guess that means a dress with a few colors in it would be better than one that's purely white!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: They're getting more excited about this than the person who's ultimately supposed to wear it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, Airi, wanna see it too?
It really is an adorable dress!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, okay, I'm coming.
